resources.string: No internet connection. Check your network and try again.
The NYT server took too long to respond. Try again.
The NYT API key is not set. Add nyt.api.key to local.properties and rebuild the app.
The NYT API key was rejected (401/403). Check that the key is valid and active.
Too many requests to the NYT API (429). Wait a minute and try again.
This section is not available on the NYT server (404).
The NYT server is temporarily unavailable (5xx). Try again later.
The server response could not be parsed. The API format may have changed.
Local database error. The saved stories could not be read.
The NYT server returned no stories for this section, and nothing is cached.
